project.name: SyncWeave

target.name: clean
target.description: Removes all files from build tree

project.description:
========================================================================= Target: developer
Purpose: Build everything except the installable images. This target is intended for runtime or studio developers who do not have InstallShield on their machines.
Notes: 1. To manually install the studio plugin, perform the following command:
xcopy |buildroot|\export\studio\* |wsadroot|\plugins /s
2. To build using this target, enter the command:
ant developer =========================================================================

========================================================================= Target: images Purpose: Builds the product but does not build the installer. Echo message left for now until both can use the same JVM again. =========================================================================

target.name: images
target.depends: package, javadoc, javadoc_internal, images_ftp, init_installer, zip_files, install_archives

echo.message: Run ant again with the build_installer to build the actuall installer.
